Work in {project_root} on {date}. V778 produced an honest availability inventory but no service timings. Complete costs determine which hardware operation could matter.
EXISTING CODE TO READ FIRST:
CLAUDE.md; CODEX.md; ops/north-star.md; ops/e2e-test-plan.md; ops/exclusion_manifest.yaml; research-references.md (V779 scan); openspec/change-proposals/research-roadmap-vNEXT.md; openspec/capabilities/research-reporting/spec.md; scripts/experiment_template.py; python/carnot/reporting/primary_publication.py; python/carnot/reporting/current_work_receipt.py; python/carnot/reporting/complete_cost_9136.py; python/carnot/reporting/complete_cost_runner_9136.py; research-hardware-wishlist.md; results/experiment_9146_v779_static_energy.json; results/experiment_9147_v779_delayed_learning.json; results/experiment_9142_v779_logit_runtime.json
TASK:
Measure complete forward and durable adaptation costs. Deliver results/experiment_9150_v779_complete_cost.json. Implement scripts/experiments/experiment_9150_v779_complete_cost.py using the existing library paths. MODEL_SPECS: [{"hf_id": "unsloth/Qwen3.8-27B-GGUF", "quantization": "Q4_K_M"}]. Requested inference_substrate_class: model_load_no_generation.
Use frozen unsloth/Qwen3.8-27B-GGUF through the embedded tokenizer and supported full-vocabulary forward path. This task does not generate tokens. The load/forward class has a 2-second floor. A later small-token canary requires model_bounded_generation (10s); real generative work requires model_full_generation (60s). Never relabel or pad a run to pass.
CONCRETE STEPS:
1. Emit a flushed progress line at each phase boundary. Emit before and after every model load, generation, benchmark and subprocess that can take minutes. Print progress inside long loops. Supervise blocking calls with flushed heartbeats every 60 seconds. Keep every silence gap below 600 seconds. Write any file over about 200 lines in several tool calls of at most 200 lines. Send a progress message between writing calls. Never use one huge tool call.
2. PRECONDITIONS: Authenticate required artifacts and their exact gate fields before dependent work. Check imports, resource limits and private disk space. Keep missing_file, missing_field and observed zero distinct. Missing external inputs produce terminal blocked evidence with gate_check_summary. Never repin historical evidence to mutable checkout code. Before any load, use cached_sota_pair() to resolve the mandated cached GGUF. Pin file and llama.cpp build hashes. Confirm GPU0 lease, actual CUDA offload, free VRAM and disk. GPU1 belongs to its existing owner. Do not download, rebuild a runtime or use CPU fallback as headline evidence.
3. Before implementation, inspect all callers with rg. Confirm REQ-REPORT-9150-V779 and SCENARIO-REPORT-9150-V779. Extend the specification first. Write failing controls before code. Freeze units, formulas, exclusions and validation scope before outcomes.
4. Run unconditionally. Before any model load, inventory exact readiness fields for contract, current qualification, runtime, admission, static predictions and online predictions. Static service may run if learning is unavailable. No scientific-positive gate is required. If no service is eligible, emit blocked_no_run and complete availability rows, not invented timings.
5. Use original first20 TEST qids/all60 siblings, three fresh processes and order seed776108. Match scientific probabilities within atol1e-5/rtol1e-4 and typed decisions exactly. Separate cold load, warm uncached raw-text verification and cached-feature head costs. Include tokenization, GPU forwards, transfers, statistics, transforms, scores and serialization.
6. For available online service, time proposals, all guard scans, rejected updates, durable write/fsync, acknowledgment, final drain and recovery. Include the six arms and every intended unit. Preserve censored work and initialization costs. Reuse qualified heads and methods; do not redesign them during timing.
7. Map measured operations to CPU, GPU and possible future native/FPGA kernels. Compute Amdahl ceilings only from actual nonoverlapping component times. Explain what fraction would need acceleration for the program's100x target and PRD10x target. Unknown fractions remain unknown. Power/energy stays unavailable unless measured integrals exist.
8. Preserve KV260 supported Ising fabric and k_max<=5; spline updates require a different qualified kernel. Preserve PolarFire CPU-only evidence and GateMate physical/JTAG block. TSU/NPU/larger FPGA wishlist items need demonstrated operation fit and access. No repeated board probe or procurement is scheduled. Extropic projections are not local measurements.
9. Run meaningful owned unit tests and actual child-process coverage with 100 percent owned statements and zero exclusions. Preserve original assertions. Run Ruff check/format, strict mypy and explicit-path scripts/check_spec_coverage.py. Execute private real CLI success, refusal, tamper and cold replay outside the checkout without PYTHONPATH, following E2E-018/021. Learning/recovery changes also require E2E-020. Separate unrelated repository health from affected failures. Affected failures disqualify readiness.
10. Stop measurement by 3300 seconds. Reserve 1200 seconds for verification within the 4800-second hard cap. Save unfinished units and censor reasons. Recompute claims from rows. Run scripts/adversarial_verify.py and scripts/verdict_row_consistency_lint.py --strict with heartbeats. Publish only through primary_publication after actual checker receipts pass. Reconcile openspec/, _bmad/traceability.md, ops/status.md and ops/changelog.md. Preserve historical primaries, quarantines and exclusions. Do not activate a roadmap or publish externally.
REQUIRED ARTIFACT FIELDS:
- honest_verdict: complete_*; principle: A terminal prefix records the actual outcome without inducing a spurious retry.
- verdict_class: positive | circular_positive | null | blocked | disqualified | partial; principle: Only unfinished owned work uses partial. Absent, retired or blocked external inputs use blocked. Fixtures never establish scientific benefit.
- gate_check_summary: list of check, upstream, path, sha256, artifact_field, op, expected, observed, passed; principle: Every blocked verdict names the failed operand. Missing files and fields are contract failures, distinct from observed zero.
- rows: unit_id, qid/group, sibling, arm/condition, seed, absolute metric, numerator, denominator, status, exclusion_reason and censor_reason; principle: Every comparison can be recomputed at its actual independent unit.
- sample_size_budget: intended, attempted, completed, failed, censored and effective_independent_groups; principle: Siblings, repeated retention and resamples cannot inflate the sample size.
- verifier_is_oracle: boolean; principle: Executable truth reused as the verifier is circular_positive, never an independent verifier win.
- claim_scope: include exposure_scope and independent_generalization_score=0; principle: This exposed human panel cannot close GAP-ORACLE-DISTINCT or GAP-DETECTOR-AUROC-4208. No ARC solve is claimed.
- MODEL_SPECS: actual requested model list with invocation status; principle: Named upstream models cannot masquerade as current inference.
- inference_substrate_class: actual work class plus requested_inference_substrate_class; principle: No-load refusals use blocked_no_run. A failed attempted load is still an attempted load. No artificial duration padding.
- inference_substrate: operation-accurate declaration; principle: Cached reduction, live forward work and generation have different evidentiary costs.
- model_invocation_counts: current_llm_invocations, loads attempted/completed/failed, forward calls and generated_tokens; principle: Current compute counters must agree with operation-specific receipts.
- duration_s: measured wall time; principle: Real process timing bounds throughput claims and detects invented compute.
- random_seed: fixed before measurement; principle: Seeds make the planned comparisons reproducible.
- reproducibility_checksum: input and configuration digest; principle: Changed evidence must not pass as the same experiment.
- source_references: producer path, SHA256 and imported fields; principle: Original evidence authority survives mutable checkout changes.
- code_config_hashes: owned implementation, tests and configuration references; principle: Validation qualifies the exact executed revision.
- current_work_receipts: actual operation-specific receipts; principle: Scripted counters and historical work cannot qualify a current model run.
- validation_receipts: commands, logs, exit status and coverage references; principle: Readiness depends on executed checks, not self-reported success.
- required_checks_passed: boolean; principle: Incomplete or failing affected checks cannot produce readiness.
- acceptance_gates: fixed conditions with one-line principle annotations; principle: Outcome-dependent thresholds cannot manufacture success.
- cost_inventory_ready_score: integer 0/1; principle: Complete availability accounting survives upstream failure.
- service_cost_ready_score: integer 0/1; principle: Whole raw-text service requires actual matched outputs and complete clocks.
- adaptation_cost_ready_score: integer 0/1; principle: Durable guard and feedback work belongs in learning cost.
- cost_rows: unit, arm, cold/warm boundary, component clocks, complete clock and censor reason; principle: A head-only speedup cannot stand in for end-to-end benefit.
- hardware_operation_rows: actual supported operation, measured fraction, Amdahl ceiling or unavailable reason; principle: Hardware recommendations require matching work.
Run command: cd {project_root} && CARNOT_FORCE_LIVE=1 CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=0 JAX_PLATFORMS=cpu .venv/bin/python -u scripts/experiments/experiment_9150_v779_complete_cost.py --date {date}
Do NOT push. Do NOT modify scripts/research_conductor.py.

- acceptance_gates: fixed conditions with one-line principle annotations; principle: Outcome-dependent thresholds cannot manufacture success.

- static_methods_ready_score: integer 0/1; principle: Static methods can be reused only under original authority.
- online_methods_ready_score: integer 0/1; principle: Reuse must retain all six arms and exact delayed-update semantics.
- full_task_objects: include canonical_task_hash and previous_outcome_rows; principle: Scheduling completion cannot be confused with scientific success.
- protocol_references: source_manifest_reference, evaluator_label_reference, static_protocol_reference, online_protocol_reference and shard roster references; principle: Consumers share immutable, identically named inputs.
Run command: cd {project_root} && JAX_PLATFORMS=cpu .venv/bin/python -u scripts/experiments/experiment_9138_v779_contract.py --date {date}
Do NOT push. Do NOT modify scripts/research_conductor.py.
